run_kilt_wow_main: run the main function to generate k-shot data for the KILT WoW dataset with multiple seeds
create_kilt_wow_dataset: create a Kilt_WoW dataset instance that loads the WikiHow Open World dataset from HuggingFace
map_hf_dataset_to_list: map a HuggingFace dataset split to a list of input-output tuples with tab-separated answers
load_kilt_wow_dataset: load the KILT WoW dataset from the kilt_tasks collection on HuggingFace datasets
generate_k_shot_data: generate k-shot training, dev, and test splits for the WoW dataset using specified seeds
